tools.name: list_design_options
tools.description: List the available themes (visual designs), fonts, icon packs, animation levels, audiences and goals for Perizent presentations. Use the returned ids in create_presentation / restyle_presentation.

tools.name: create_presentation
tools.description: Start building a Persian presentation deck. Returns a job_id immediately (status running, or queued if the server is full); the deck takes about 1-3 minutes, poll get_presentation for status and download links. input_mode: 'topic' = a short description, AI writes all content (20-2000 chars); 'full_t

tools.name: get_presentation
tools.description: Get the status of a presentation job. When status is 'done' it returns download links (PPTX, PDF; paid plans only, otherwise download_locked with a note) and slide preview images; links are valid for 7 days.

tools.name: restyle_presentation
tools.description: Re-render a finished deck with another theme, font, icon pack, animation level, image style or brand in a few seconds (content stays the same). Poll get_presentation afterwards for the new links.

tools.name: share_presentation
tools.description: Create or update the public online-presentation link of a finished deck (anyone with the link views it full-screen in the browser, no account needed; it always shows the latest version). Optional password, optional PPTX/PDF download for viewers, or revoke the link. Returns the URL and view statistic

tools.name: account_info
tools.description: Name, plan and this month's credits (used, remaining, reset date) of the account behind this access key, plus the plan's limits and the account's default settings for new decks.

tools.name: set_defaults
tools.description: Change the account's defaults for new presentations (the same settings as the website profile): animation level and/or image style. Returns the new defaults.

tools.name: list_presentations
tools.description: List the presentations created with this access key (newest first).

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "share_presentation" references sensitive artifacts (password). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: share_presentation · Private data: share_presentation · Public sink: share_presentation · Destructive: account_info.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: share_presentation · Private data: share_presentation · Public sink: share_presentation · Destructive: account_info

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
